infobox.japanese: 大司祭、ユミル卿; (Daishisai, Yumiru-kyō)

npcs.summary: Count Ymir, High Priest, later known as Ymir, Mother of Fingers, is a character in Shadow of the Erdtree.
overview: Ymir is a glintstone sorcerer who resides in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr. Ymir once instructed Rellana, a princess of the Carian Royal Family, however he abandoned his alliegence to the moon, believing it to be merely the closest of the celestial bodies. He is served by Jolán, Swordhand of Night, who is fiercely loyal to her count.

Ymir possesses insight into the nature of the world, claiming that we are children of the Greater Will, born as stardust from a rapture far across the skies. He believes that Queen Marika, the Two Fingers, and their mother have been defective from the start. Ymir himself aspires to become a mother of fingers. When the Tarnished meets Ymir, he gives them a hollowed-out stone necklace and tasks them with sounding the bells at the Finger Ruins of Rhia and Dheo. After the bells have been rung, Ymir sends them to the Finger Ruins of Miyr, located below the cathedral, to sound the final bell. Doing so transports them to another place, where they encounter and defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers. Following this, Ymir succeeds in becoming a mother of Fingers himself and attacks the Tarnished, only to be defeated.

npcs.name: Dragon Communion Priestess
npcs.summary: The Dragon Communion Priestess or Ancient Dragon Florissax is a NPC in Shadow of the Erdtree.
overview: Florissax is an Ancient Dragon who assumed a human form to share Dragon Comunion with the world. A loyal servant of Dragonlord Placidusax, Florissax offers her sleep to her lord each night, to receive his blessing in turn. She seeks to aid in the destruction of Bayle the Dread, a Dragon who turned on Placidusax and inflicted a grievous wound upon him long ago.

When she meets the Tarnished, Florissax reveals the true purpose of Dragon Communion: to hunt and devour Bayle and his bloodline. She encourages the Tarnished to partake in Dragon Communion, and urges them to slay Bayle.

The Tarnished may give her Thiollier's Concoction, causing her to fall asleep and break her pledge to Placidusax. If the Tarnished admits to doing so, Florissax will declare them to be her new Lord, becoming a spirit ash.

notes: The base game previously established a dragons' ability to take on a human form with Ancient Dragon Lansseax, although the Priestess marks the first example of this that the player can encounter.

npcs.name: Igon

infobox.japanese: エーゴン; (Ēgon)

npcs.summary: Igon is an NPC in Shadow of the Erdtree.
overview: Igon was once a poor scavenger of battlefields, but found honour in the ancient art of Dragon Communion, whereby hunters of dragons could consume their hearts to gain their strength.

Igon soon became a fearless drake warrior and set his eyes on the greatest prey of all: Bayle the Dread, progenitor of the drakes, and the very reason that Dragon Communion had been created. Driven by bottomless hunger and fiery ambition, Igon journeyed to Bayle's roost at the top of the Jagged Peak to challenge the dragon. However, Igon found himself outmatched. Bayle shattered both Igon's body and mind, leaving him broken and terrified.

Despite this, Igon willed himself to climb back towards the Jagged Peak. Here he encountered a Tarnished champion also hunting for Bayle. Igon begged the Tarnished to summon his soul when facing Bayle so that he might have his revenge. Together, the two drake warriors succeed in slaying Bayle, allowing Igon to die in peace.

npcs.name: Dryleaf Dane
npcs.summary: Dryleaf Dane is an NPC in Shadow of the Erdtree.
overview: Dane is a member of the Dryleaf Sect, an order of spiritual seekers who chose to serve a new god after seeing the decline of the Erdtree in the fallen leaves. Dane fights using an unarmed technique which focuses on kicks.

Dane is a compatriot of Needle Knight Leda, and has been in the service of Miquella even longer than she has. He seldom speaks, and even Leda has never heard his voice. The The Tarnished may challenge him to a duel in Scadu Altus, after which he will grant them access to Dryleaf Arts. He can optionally be summoned to fight against Romina, Saint of the Bud at the Church of the Bud.

Dane discovers the sealing tree in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh and deduces that it must be burnt using the flame of Messmer the Impaler. After it has been burnt, Dane joins Leda in Enir-Ilim, where they face off against the Tarnished. Upon his defeat he finally breaks his silence, offering a plea for Miquella to rise to godhood.

npcs.summary: Fire Knight Queelign is a character and invader in Shadow of the Erdtree.
overview: Queenlign is a Fire Knight, an order of knights under the command of Messmer the Impaler. As a Fire Knight, Queenlign is wholly committed the Crusade, the genocide of all Hornsent and those spurned of grace. Queenlign is so devoted that he took his greatsword and remade it to be in the shape of the lance wielded by his lord, hoping to one day become a second impaler.
However, Queenlign is not only devoted to Messmer and his mission, but also to Queen Marika the Eternal, killing the impure in her name.

Fire Knight Queenlign invades the Tarnished in two locations, Belurat, Tower Settlement and the Church of the Crusade, but falls both times. Upon his second defeat, he will drop the Prayer Room Key. Once the Tarnished reaches the Shadow Keep, they can use the key to unlock the door to the prayer room, in which they will find Queenlign collapsed and curled up on the ground, praying for Queen Marika to grant him grace. If the Tarnished gives Queelign the Iris of Grace, Queenlign will become blessed and remember his resolve, and vows to continue excising all those who stand in the way of Queen Marika's peace. However, this blessing was short lived, and after being saved by grace, the only thing left for him was to continue fighting as a spirit ash. If given the Iris of Occultation, he will die, thinking that Queen Marika is punishing him for not being pure enough despite all his efforts. He will then drop his weapon for the Tarnished to use.
notes: Queelign and Messmer share an internal struggle with their loyalties to Queen Marika.
Both times Queelign invades the player, he will perform a unique gesture before fighting.

npcs.summary: The Forager Brood is a group of friendly creatures in Shadow of the Erdtree.
overview: These insectoids of the same species as the Kindred of Rot can be found throughout the Realm of Shadow. They gather supplies from all corners of the land. The foragers are not aggressive, and will share their crafting techniques when spoken with. They are typically found hunched over, digging in the ground.

Moore is of the same brood, and his kin share crafting techniques with him and his allies out of kindness. They also produce pickled foods, using a fermenting technique that enhances the effects of the meat and creates a pungent odor.
The mother of the foragers did not love them. After she abandoned them, they sought the love of Kindly Miquella to banish their pain and sadness.

npcs.name: Hornsent Grandam
npcs.summary: The Hornsent Grandam is a character in Shadow of the Erdtree. She is located behind a locked door in a storeroom at Belurat, Tower Settlement. Small Private Altar is the nearest Site of Grace.
overview: An old hornsent bitter with resentment towards Marika, Messmer, and any of their ilk, since during the Crusade many hornsent perished, their lands were burnt, and their tower veiled in shadow. Many of them used to live at tower settlement of Belurat, where she can still be found.

When approached, she will think of the Tarnished as one of Messmer's peons with ill intentions. If the Divine Beast Head is equipped, she will then think of the player as a revered ally, and her attitude will deeply change.
notes: The Hornsent Grandam defends herself with the Watchful Spirit spell when attacked.

If the player defeats the Hornsent Grandam (she falls over but remains inert) before triggering the introductory cutscene for the Divine Beast Dancing Lion at Belurat, the cutscene will be altered. The Grandam's voice weakens, becoming raspier, with more direct and desperate pleas.

Is there more to his motives for cooperation? Like Freyja, you can find Hornsent at the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace on the Gravesite Plains."

infobox.japanese: 針の騎士, レダ (Hari no Kishi, Reda)

npcs.summary: Needle Knight Leda is an NPC in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree. Standing out among her fellows for her single-minded devotion to Lord Miquella, Leda is the de-facto leader of the Empyrean's followers, guiding the Tarnished into the Land of Shadow.
overview: A member of the Needle Knights, an order devoted to Miquella of the Haligtree. Leda was guided by Miquella to the Realm of Shadow alongside her compatriots, all of whom were under the influence of a powerful charm which compelled them to follow the Empyrean. While in the Realm of Shadow, Leda followed the trail of crosses left by Miquella, discovering in the process that he sought the Gate of Divinity, which was sealed away by a tree.

The Tarnished encounters Leda in Mohgwyn Palace, where she urges them to touch the withered arm in Miquella's cocoon to enter the Realm of Shadow. Within the Land of Shadow, the Tarnished meets Leda and her various compatriots on their search for Miquella, seeking out the crosses to ascertain his route. However, the charm inflicted upon the compatriots is broken when Miquella's Great Rune is shattered. Leda's devotion to Miquella is unshaken, but she begins to suspect her compatriots of disloyalty. Leda sets about ferreting out those she believes undeserving of a place at Miquella's side, with her potential targets being the Hornsent and Sir Ansbach. The Tarnished may assist her in her hunt, or side with her opponents.

After gaining access to Enir-Ilim, the Tarnished encounters Leda for a final time on the way to the Gate of Divinity. Leda deduces that the Tarnished was never guided by Miquella, and concludes that they were instead following the guidance of the Erdtree. Viewing the Tarnished as a threat to Miquella's ascension, she challenges them. The Tarnished triumphs over Leda and her remaining allies, and continues to the top of the tower.

npcs.name: Redmane Freyja
npcs.summary: Redmane Freyja is an NPC in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
overview: Formerly one of the most distinguished knights of Starscourge Radahn, who invited her into his ranks after witnessing her valour as a gladiator, Freyja is one of the compatriots of Needle Knight Leda who followed Miquella into the Realm of Shadow.

In the past, Freyja was stricken by Scarlet Rot in the Swamp of Aeonia. Left behind and resigned to death, she was approached by Miquella, who put his lips to her wound and drained the poison from it. Freyja was subsequently charmed by Miquella, and later entered the Realm of Shadow with Leda and her compatriots.

After Miquella's charm is broken, Freyja chooses to strike out on her own, although she remains loyal to Miquella. She recalls Miquella mentioning a vow he once made with her former lord Radahn, and resolves to learn the nature of the vow. To this end, she travels to the Shadow Keep, where she has difficulty reading the letters etched into the stone tablets. With assistance from the The Tarnished and Sir Ansbach, Freyja learns that Miquella wishes to revive the soul of General Radahn. Freyja welcomes this, believing that endless war would suit her former master better than an honourable death.
Later, Freyja joins Leda and Dryleaf Dane in Enir-Ilim, in their fight against the Tarnished. Upon her defeat, she praises the Tarnished for providing her with a glorious battle.

npcs.summary: Sir Ansbach is an NPC introduced in Shadow of the Erdtree. A wizened knight in service to Mohg, Sir Ansbach follows the call of Miquella into the Land of Shadow.
overview: Formerly the feared commander of the Pureblood Knights in service of Lord Mohg, Ansbach is one of the compatriots of Needle Knight Leda who followed Miquella into the Realm of Shadow. Ansbach has dedicated himself to investigating Miquella's purpose by following the trail of crosses he left behind.

As with the rest who followed Miquella into the Shadow Realm, Ansbach was under the influence of a charm, which breaks when the Empyrean abandons his Miquella's Great Rune. With his mind freed of the charm, Ansbach recalls that he once challenged Miquella in an attempt to free Mohg of his enchantment, which resulted in him falling under the enchantment himself.

With his faculties restored, Ansbach makes his way to the Specimen Storehouse within the Shadow Keep. There, he learns that Mohg's body has been taken to Miquella, and with the assistance of the Tarnished discovers that Miquella intends to use Mohg's corpse as a vessel for his king consort.

Ansbach becomes one of Leda's possible targets, resulting in a duel which the Tarnished may intervene in on either side. Should Ansbach survive Leda's attack, he will aid the Tarnished against Leda, Dryleaf Dane, and their allies in Enir-Ilim. Ansbach will then be available to assist the Tarnished in their battle against Promised Consort Radahn, before which he admits that he knows the Tarnished was responsible for killing Mohg, but bears no grudge against them, viewing Mohg's death as an honorable one. After defeating Miquella and his consort, Ansbach dies in front of the Gate of Divinity.

8. Sir Ansbach will be available to summon for the NPC battle in Enir-Ilim.

9. Sir Ansbach will be available to summon for the Final Boss. After the fight, Ansbach's body can be found seated near the arena's entrance, dropping Ansbach's Set, Obsidian Lamina, and Furious Blade of Ansbach.

npcs.name: St. Trina

infobox.japanese: 聖女トリーナ (Seijo Torīna)

npcs.summary: St. Trina is an NPC in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
overview: St. Trina is an enigmatic and fleeting individual who is said to appear in dreams. While they are generally thought to be a young girl or boy, St. Trina is sometimes depicted in an adult form that is said to be unnerving to look at.

Trina has attracted a following of priests rumored to use sleep-inducing arrows for ritual purposes. A man was once so utterly captivated by St. Trina that he was said to have searched for her in his sleep. This obsession led to the creation of numerous remedies for invoking dreams.
Trina's Lily is seen as a symbol of faith in the saint, and it is used to dull the senses and prevent agitation.

St. Trina is the other half of Miquella discarded along his path through the Land of Shadow. She lies at the bottom of the Stone Coffin Fissure, within the Garden of Deep Purple. Despite her abandonment, Trina's love for Miquella remained boundless. For this reason, she wished for Miquella to be killed, for she knew that his godhood would be his prison.
St. Trina appears as a slumbering child with flowing violet hair swaddled within the nurturing petals of a motherly purple flower. Drinking its nectar will surely bring eternal sleep.
notes: Dolores the Sleeping Arrow utilises St. Trina's Arrows in combat, possibly suggesting that she is one of his followers.
The Putrescent Knight became devoted to St. Trina after imbibing her nectar.
Prior to the release of Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree there were several hints that Miquella and St. Trina were closely related:
→ Both St. Trina and Miquella are typically characterised as children and are both associated with water lilies.

→ Fevor's cookbooks were made by a devout of St. Trina, containing crafting recipes related to her powers of slumber. One of them contains the recipe for the Bewitching Branch, an item originating from Miquella, blessed with an incantation of Unalloyed Gold.
→ The area in Altus Plateau where the Amber Starlight is found is internally referred to as "St. Trina's Hideaway", and it has a statue of Miquella and his twin, Malenia.
→ The Albinauric archers in the Consecrated Snowfield, who guard the approach to Miquella's Haligtree, drop St. Trina's Arrows, and have lily motifs on their armor.
→ The Cleanrot Knights, who serve Malenia, Blade of Miquella, have a chance to drop both Miquella's Lily and Trina's Lily.
[Cut Content]
Several forms of cut content for St. Trina exist revolving around the removed dreambrew mechanic and collection of slumber fog with a tool referred to as St Trina's Crystal Ball.
→ In one version, Trina is referred to as St. Trina of the Cradlesong and is implied to have granted succour to frenzied merchants by singing a lullaby to help them sleep.

→ In another version, there is a cut NPC called Rhico gives a quest to create Dreambrew, and after finding his way to Mohgwyn Palace and Miquella's cocoon, his dialogue explicitly reveals St. Trina was to be the same as Miquella.

He seems to be a very adept poison expert, and he is in search of the means to create a unique elixir. He sees himself as utterly weak and useless, apart from his skills in the realm of mixing poisons.
Can be found by himself, quite some distance from his compatriots, at the Pillar Path Cross Site of Grace on the northeastern border of the Gravesite Plain.
The Tarnished (Protagonist) can help Thiollier to create the condensed, somniferous elixir, purported to be capable of putting even an ancient dragon to sleep, although fatal for any mortal.
Should his questline be completed, Thiollier is able to see St. Trina once more.

Lanya is a character in Elden Ring. She is a servant of House Hoslow and childhood companion of Diallos Hoslow.

npcs.summary: Bloody Finger Okina (血の指、翁) is an NPC cooperator and invader in Elden Ring.
overview: Okina (meaning "Old Man" in Japanese) is a great swordsman from the Land of Reeds whose nickname came from the wooden mask that depicts an old man baring his teeth. He had several disciples in a group called the White Reeds, combatants who seek proper deaths won honorably through hard-fought combat. The head disciples of Okina were called the Inaba (Japanese name for the leaves of the rice plant).

As time passed, the more Okina sharpened his mind, the more the absurdities of the world came into stark relief. And so he renounced it all, and rose to a higher plane. There was only himself. His katana. And its mastery. This eventually led him to Mohg, Lord of Blood, and, when Mohg first felt Okina's sword, and madness, upon his flesh, he had a proposal: to offer Okina the life of a demon, whose thirst would never go unsated.
Before long, Okina became a demon of a swordsman, known as the only to wield an auxiliary weapon in his left hand while using a full-sized cursed katana in his right.

The Inaba traveled to the Lands Between in pursuit of the master who abandoned them and, desiring nothing more than to die by the sword, also sought proper deaths. And so, all that was known of them was that their armor and spirit were left lingering in the Spiritcaller Cave.

overview: The Noble Broken Mask was Goldmask's closest disciple, and a dear friend who accompanied him on his great venture. Lord Goldmask was a staunch pursuer of Golden Order fundamentalism. Upon the splintering of the Golden Order, so too did these companions part ways. One kept the faith, though the faith itself was broken, while the other fell completely to his own doubts. infobox.japanese: 二本指; (Nihonyubi)

npcs.summary: The Two Fingers are NPC characters in Elden Ring. They serve as vassals to the Greater Will in the Lands Between.
overview: [Appearance]
Two Fingers have an appearance resembling part of a giant hand, with a slight indentation in the “palm”, and two finger-like appendages on the top, hence their name.
[Background]

The Two Fingers are the children of Metyr, Mother of Fingers, and serve as divine envoys of the Greater Will. They are responsible for selecting Empyreans, granting them shadowbound beasts, and guiding their path toward inheriting the Elden Ring. The Fingers were present when the Empyrean Marika wove the Erdtree into existence from the primordial Crucible of life.

In the past, the Fingers were masters of oration, their wisdom attracting champions to Roundtable Hold. They were said to communicate using a language of light, composed of intangible symbols that appeared to hang in the air. These inscriptions could be fashioned into weapons such as the Cipher Pata and the Coded Sword. The Two Fingers are also the source of Two Fingers Incantations and possess the ability to restore the blessings of the Great Runes atop the ancient Divine Towers.

The Fingers are attended by Finger Readers, who interpret their wisdom for the Tarnished, those to whom Grace has returned. Churches dedicated to the Two Fingers exist beyond the Lands Between, served by confessors who hunt down their enemies. While some Tarnished remain faithful, the Fingers are now believed to be corrupted and senile, having been broken along with the Erdtree long ago.
location_details: One living Two Fingers can be found in Roundtable Hold, behind a set of doors that remain closed until the Tarnished champion acquires their first Great Rune. They will be at the back of the chamber with Finger Reader Enia sitting close by. The Two Fingers here appears to be in a state of decay, missing patches of skin with exposed flesh on its body and “fingers”.

There are several Two Fingers that can be found throughout the Lands Between. They can be found at the top of the Divine Towers littered about the world, however, they appear to have long since died through unknown means.
notes: The Two Fingers cannot be attacked or killed through any means during normal gameplay.
→ They can only be harmed by the Fingerslayer Blade, wielded by someone with a destined fate.
The individuals known to have been named Empyrean by the Two Fingers include Malenia, Miquella, Ranni, the Gloam-Eyed Queen, and Queen Marika herself.
The Finger Mimic mushrooms were known as the "stillborn of the Two Fingers." These fungi were harvested and consumed by the finger-weavers for their hallucinogenic properties.

npcs.summary: Vyke is a non-playable character in Elden Ring.
overview: Vyke was a Tarnished champion better known for being the closest to becoming Elden Lord before the arrival of the player protagonist.

Vyke went on to the Roundtable Hold, where he got the title of Roundtable Knight. At a similar time he met Lansseax, and became her most loved knight. She shared with him Ancient Dragon incantations, many of which Vyke mastered to the point he got one named after him called Vyke's Dragonbolt, a signature move that electrified his body and lance, and which probably is the origin of the nickname Vyke the Dragonspear.

No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But, without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy. It is believed he either did it for his maiden, or was lured there by other force. According to a Stranded Soul, he was expected to then become the Lord of Frenzied Flame but, for some reason, he didn't. Instead, he was imprisioned in an Evergaol, although he still invades those who approach the Church of Inhibition in the Frenzied Flame Village.
